command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own original242');const m=document.querySelector('#itemTwinModal'),r=document.querySelector('#twinCurrent');const shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Twin show timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#itemTwinModal"]').click();await shown;return {shown:true,currentText:r.innerText};})()

steps.label: 3184-own-original242-discarded-set389-filter-search
command: (()=>{const f=document.querySelector('#twinSearchFilter');if(f.querySelector('[name=anchorItemId]').value!=='2089242'||document.querySelector('#twinAddTabBtn').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw Error('Original242 Add filter');f.querySelector('[name=keywordType]').value='itemId';f.querySelector('[name=keywordType]').dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));const k=f.querySelector('[name=keyword]');k.value='2089389';k.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));for(const c of f.querySelectorAll('[name=statuses]'))if(c.checked!==(c.value==='D'))c.click();f.querySelector('[data-twin-search]').click();return {keyword:k.value,checkedStatuses:[...f.querySelectorAll('[name=statuses]:checked')].map(e=>e.value)};})()

command: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#itemTwinModal'),i=bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(m);if(!m.classList.contains('show')||i._isTransitioning)throw Error('Stable twin modal');const done=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Twin hide timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});m.querySelector('.modal-header [data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();await done;return {visibleModals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>e.id)};})()
